scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n server,web,proxy -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @glitch/server" "npm run dev -w @glitch/web" "node apps/web/proxy.mjs"
scripts.start: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n server,web,proxy -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run start -w @glitch/server" "npm run start -w @glitch/web" "node apps/web/proxy.mjs"
